title: Proceeding
description: A legal matter — case, action, enforcement docket. Bound to gist:Event (subtype LegalProceeding). A Proceeding accumulates Allegations and Determinations over its lifetime.

title.description: Public matter caption (e.g., 'Moffatt v. Air Canada').

issuedBy.description: IRI of the of:Authority hearing the matter.

hasAllegation.description: IRIs of of:Allegation records in this matter.

hasDetermination.description: IRIs of of:Determination records in this matter. Multiple Determinations are expected over a Proceeding's lifetime (trial, appeal, reversal).

source.description: Authoritative source URL (court database, official record).

neutral_citation.description: Neutral citation (e.g. '2024 BCCRT 149'). Crosswalk for common-law neutral-citation jurisdictions without ECLI (crosswalk matrix in PROTOCOL.md).

ref.description: Jurisdiction code: lowercase form of an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country/supranational code or an ISO 3166-2 subdivision code.

sameAs.description: owl:sameAs crosswalk IRIs: external records identical to this one (e.g. a live adopter export, a Wikidata entity).

exactMatch.description: skos:exactMatch crosswalk IRIs: external concepts interchangeably usable with this record. Weaker than owl:sameAs; preferred for cross-scheme concept joins.

notes.description: Free-text editorial or provenance notes about this record.
